review_method.context_read: Each of the 405 stable locations was resolved against the r13t candidate bytes. The 419 raw members were reconciled through member_count; no finding was dropped.
review_method.semantic_basis: Disposition used the exact syntactic or serialized field role, enclosing fixture/evidence semantics, and source provenance. Path role alone was never treated as proof of harmlessness.
review_method.repetition_check: Repeated content was attributed only where byte identity, synchronized declaration equality, checker output identity, or exact-byte manifest bindings established a common source.
review_method.credential_validation: No value was sent to a provider or external service.
review_method.authority_limit: This review does not authorize a broad allowlist, directory ignore, rule ignore, threshold reduction, snapshot rewrite, rotation completion, release, or Stage 3 acceptance.

repetition_analysis.basis: exact candidate-relative path, rule, and start/end location; all are imported README long-line contexts
stage manifest file_sha256 and declared source path
five specification-generator pairs privately verified to carry equal PROJECT_KEY declarations
three command-header lines privately verified byte-identical

reason_catalog.FP_WORKFLOW_RECORD_IDENTIFIER: The exact line stores a workflow task, record, or idempotency identifier used for correlation and replay. It is not consumed as authentication material.
reason_catalog.FP_PROJECT_SELECTOR: The exact line stores a project or tenant selector. Cross-file comparison confirms the same domain identifier in specifications, generators, tests, and generated snapshots; it is not an authentication key.
reason_catalog.FP_SHA256_DIGEST: The exact line is a SHA-256 inventory value keyed by a repository-relative file path. It is integrity metadata, not a credential.
reason_catalog.FP_METRIC_LOOKUP_KEY: The exact line passes a metric field name to a numeric lookup helper. The detected literal names latency data and is not authentication material.
reason_catalog.FP_DOCUMENT_VARIABLE_REFERENCE: The exact documentation example passes an uppercase in-scope variable to a client constructor; no credential literal is embedded in the example.
reason_catalog.FP_SYNTHETIC_TEST_VALUE: The exact value is created inside a bounded test fixture and is used only as a local domain or protocol specimen. No external provider or persisted production credential is involved.
reason_catalog.FP_DOMAIN_DIGEST: The exact line uses a digest-valued domain witness in a test. The value is comparison data, not authentication material.
reason_catalog.FP_ENVIRONMENT_EXPANSION: The exact operations line expands an environment variable at runtime. The repository contains the variable reference, not its value.
reason_catalog.FP_PROJECT_HEADER: The exact command supplies X-Project-Key as a project-routing selector. Application middleware resolves project context from this header; it is not the authentication boundary.
reason_catalog.FIX_DEMO_TELEMETRY_CAPTURE: The exact location is third-party browser telemetry copied into demo seed HTML. The client-side identifier is unrelated to the fixture domain and can be deterministically redacted while preserving the embedded script or JSON shape.
reason_catalog.FROZEN_IMPORTED_README: The exact context is an imported third-party README example, inline payload, or key block. Local evidence does not establish harmlessness or active credential status, and no external validation was performed; the frozen snapshot needs sanitized migration or an exact-location exception decision.

agent-core-live-audit-capture.same_source_basis: SSE and JSON outputs from the same bounded live-audit capture family; repeated fields are serialized task and record identifiers.

scheduler-queue-replay-checker.same_source_basis: Both JSON artifacts use the scheduler queue-handoff replay contract shape; repeated task, logical-list, record, and idempotency fields share this generator/checker mechanism.

scheduler-live-closure-checker.same_source_basis: Repeated workflow identifiers are emitted by one live-scheduler closure artifact shape.

manual-structured-consumer-live-capture.same_source_basis: The two findings are routing-header instances inside one preserved manual API capture; no broader generator identity is asserted.

successor-all-lines-sha256-inventory.same_source_basis: All three findings are values in the same changed-files SHA-256 mapping.

successor-p4-c7-fragment-generator.same_source_basis: The fragment and downstream exact-byte snapshots are generated or byte-copied from this family source.

successor-p4-c8-fragment-generator.same_source_basis: The fragment and downstream exact-byte snapshots are generated or byte-copied from this family source.

successor-exact-byte-rebind-pipeline.same_source_basis: Each candidate snapshot is bound by its stage family manifest to an exact source path and file SHA-256; repeated stage copies are therefore same-byte descendants, not independent findings.

external-readme-snapshot-import.same_source_basis: Identity is limited to each exact imported README path. No common local generator or cross-upstream equivalence is asserted.

twitter-api-setup-doc-template.same_source_basis: All three files are byte-identical and the same constructor argument spans the same lines.

successor-project-selector-declarations.same_source_basis: Private comparison confirmed equality within each of the five specification-generator PROJECT_KEY pairs; values are not retained in this review.

release-project-header-template.same_source_basis: The three detected header lines are byte-identical copies of one curl request template.

demo-seed-captured-html.same_source_basis: Both findings occur in third-party browser telemetry embedded in the same demo seed, but they are distinct telemetry mechanisms and remain separate remediation groups.

direct-candidate-source.kind: direct source, config, documentation, or test fixture
direct-candidate-source.identity: the exact relative_path carried by each group
direct-candidate-source.same_source_basis: No cross-file same-source claim is made unless another catalog entry explicitly states one.

mechanically_fixable_items.change: Replace the embedded browser telemetry client identifier with a short redaction marker before fixture serialization; preserve the surrounding script structure.
Replace the embedded browser monitoring configuration identifier with a short redaction marker before fixture serialization; preserve the surrounding JSON structure.

fix_verification: Parse and load the edited SQL seed into a disposable PostgreSQL database using main/backend/scripts/load_demo_proj_seed.sh.
Rebuild the candidate and run the unchanged Gitleaks policy; reconcile the fresh denominator and confirm the two exact locations are absent without new findings.

frozen_snapshot_decision.scope: four exact imported README snapshots under docs/reference-pool/platformization/snapshots/
frozen_snapshot_decision.required_decision: For each exact stable location, choose a sanitized successor snapshot or an exact-location exception. The review does not approve either choice.
frozen_snapshot_decision.rotation_statement: No group was promoted to rotation or revocation from local evidence alone; this is not evidence that external material is inactive.
